conviction_note: VTURA is the target in a live all-share LOI with SED Energy Holdings (ENH, 5.50x, signed 2026-09-11, no definitive agreement yet). Both companies report before the Oslo open on 2026-11-27, so the window is driven by ENH's own reaction (VTURA beta to ENH 0.59, correlation 0.68 since the LOI), any transaction update and the capex re-estimate Ventura promised for this report, which the LOI ties to the consideration. Ventura's own Q3 numbers are close to noise. The findings sum to +0.1 and nearly cancel: a small catch-up lean from the stale exchange ratio, against a small asymmetric risk from the capex update. abs_move 4.5 because two unknown lines (deal status, capex/consideration) and the acquirer's print all land in one session, well above this name's 0.61% pre-deal results median. p_up 53 because everything I have is proxy or inference, so the scaled +0.27 and the +0.1 sum agree in sign and are both small.

already_public.what: All-share LOI: ENH to acquire 100% of Ventura at 5.50 ENH shares per VTURA share (605m consideration shares, maximum), subject to adjustments for CAPEX and commencement of new rig contracts; completion expected Q1 2027 via Bermuda scheme

Binding DNB financing: USD 250m bridge (SOFR+500, 12-month bullet) plus USD 30m RCF extension, 'expected to fully fund the Company until commencement of new contracts with Petrobras for DS Carolina and SSV Victoria, currently expected in January 2027'; not contingent on the ENH deal; bond VEOFF01 called at 101.5
Bond call redemption condition satisfied, settlement 2026-10-22
SSV Catarina contract amendment for an additional well (Eni, Indonesia)
Deep Value Driller marketing and operations agreement, with a PETRONAS contract in Indonesia

Q3 operating set-up already known: SSV Victoria's Petrobras contract expired 2026-07-07 and the rig is in contract preparation, overhaul and class work until a January 2027 start; DS Carolina extended about four months to ~September/January; Catarina utilised into Q4
ENH (the acquirer) reports Q3 2026 at 06:00 CET on the same morning, 2026-11-27

new_in_release.expect: Updated cost estimate for the DS Carolina / SSV Victoria preparation projects (previously 'up to $130 million, net of mobilization fee'). The Q2 report promised it for this report, and the LOI adjusts the consideration shares for CAPEX. Direction unknown. The October funding statement argues against a large overrun, but rig yard projects tend to overrun, so the risk is skewed slightly negative.
Transaction status: definitive combination agreement, timetable, any change to the 5.50x ratio. Direction unknown. Signing would tighten a 14% spread; a delay or a renegotiated ratio would widen it.

Confirmation or slippage of the January 2027 Petrobras start dates for Carolina and Victoria, which is also an LOI adjustment condition. Expected unchanged, as the company restated January 2027 on 2026-10-07.
Lower revenue and EBITDA as Victoria is off-hire in yard. Known and not sized; no sourced consensus for Q3.
Q3 capex burn and cash after the yard spend. Bridge financing closed in October, so not a liquidity event.

findings.finding: The Q3 report is the promised venue for an updated cost estimate on the Carolina/Victoria preparation projects (previously 'up to $130 million'), and the LOI adjusts the number of consideration shares for CAPEX. An overrun therefore lands directly on what VTURA holders receive. The 2026-10-07 statement that the new DNB financing fully funds the company until a January 2027 start limits the overrun tail, so the net risk is small and slightly negative.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior capex re-estimate under the LOI. The 2026-04-02 capex and financing update (which set the $130m figure and the $75m tap) is not in the results-day history. The closest observable is 2026-08-31, when Fearnley cut its target to NOK 37 from 39 after Q2.
findings.why_not_priced: The estimate does not exist publicly yet; the company said it will publish it in this report ('the Company expects to announce an updated estimate in its third quarter report'). How the LOI's CAPEX adjustment converts an overrun into fewer consideration shares has not been published, so the market cannot price the mapping. If an overrun were priced, VTURA would trade at a persistently wider spread than its post-LOI median (~10.7%). It is at 14.1%, which is consistent with but not proof of this.
findings.independence: LOI terms: 'final number of Consideration Shares to be issued will be subject to certain adjustments related to CAPEX and commencement of new contracts' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=682082, 2026-09-11). Offsetting: 'Proceeds from the New Financing are expected to fully fund the Company until commencement of new contracts ... currently expected in January 2027' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=683729, 2026-10-07). Merged here, because both bear on the same question.

findings.finding: The VTURA/ENH price ratio is 4.82 against the 5.50 deal ratio, a 14.1% gross spread. That is the wide end of its post-LOI range (ratio 4.65-5.19, median 4.96), because VTURA (23,864 shares traded today) has not followed ENH's +7.3% rebound from 6.18 to 6.63 over the last three sessions. Both companies release on the same morning, which brings volume to the stale leg.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Since the LOI, VTURA has repeatedly closed ratio gaps with a lag. 2026-11-04 ratio 4.86 -> 5.11 the next day. 2026-10-27 4.81 -> 4.92 by 10-30. 2026-09-16 4.65 -> 5.07 by 09-22. Daily beta to ENH 0.59, correlation 0.68 (Yahoo daily closes).
findings.why_not_priced: VTURA turns over about $245k a day. The lag sits in the thin leg: the ratio moved on ENH's price, not on VTURA trades (38,943 and 23,864 shares on 11-25/26). If the market were pricing deal break or a ratio cut, the widening would come with VTURA volume and selling, and it did not. Caveat: the 11-20 VTURA drop of -6.6% on 168k shares is unexplained, and an unexplained relative drawdown is worth little, so this is kept small.
findings.independence: ENH series: https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/ENH.OL?range=3mo&interval=1d (6.18 on 11-23 -> 6.63 on 11-26). The same Yahoo vendor supplies both series, so this is not independent of the source.

findings.finding: Eleven weeks after the LOI there is still no definitive combination agreement on NewsWeb, while completion is targeted for Q1 2027 through a Bermuda scheme that needs an ENH EGM and a court process. Both parties report on the same morning, so a status update (signing, a slip or renegotiated terms) is likely in the window. Its sign cannot be sourced.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: LOI day 2026-09-11: VTURA +7.9% (34.2 -> 36.9) on 3.7m shares, with the stock already up 14% from 30.0 on 09-04. The spread then ranged 6-18%.
findings.why_not_priced: The status itself is unknown, so there is nothing to price beyond the spread's deal-risk discount. Sized at 0 because I cannot sign it. It is the main reason abs_move_pct sits well above this name's own reaction history.
findings.independence: LOI: 'There can be no assurance that a definitive combination agreement will be entered into' (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=682082). Web search found no report of a signing (worldoil 2026-09-11, https://worldoil.com/news/2026/9/11/energy-holdings-ventura-offshore-sign-loi-for-1-billion-combination).

findings.finding: ENH, whose shares are the consideration, moved its Q2 2026 USD 25m distribution ex-date from 9 November to 7 December without giving a reason, ahead of the Q3 report in which it declares the Q3 distribution against a reiterated FY guide of USD 90-110m. VTURA reaches this only through its 0.59 beta to ENH.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: ENH fell 4.6% on 2026-11-05 (6.89 -> 6.57), the session after the deferral notice; VTURA was flat that day and fell 3.3% the next.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: ENH already fell on the notice. What is left is whether the Q3 declaration is also smaller or deferred. That is an inference about the acquirer, carried at beta 0.59, so it is nearly 0.
findings.independence: ENH FY distribution guide USD 90-110m reiterated in Q2 (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=680768, 2026-08-26). Original ex-date 9 Nov (https://api3.oslo.oslobors.no/v1/newsreader/message?messageId=681651).

baseline_tension: The baseline lean is +0.18 (run-up only; no short anchor) and the 20-day run-up is -3.61%. My small net-positive sum agrees with the lean's sign, but it rests on the exchange-ratio lag rather than on anything the baseline measures. The baseline's reaction history (0.61% median) predates the LOI and understates a day on which the acquirer and the target both report.
language_note: Nothing the English sources did not already carry. Every Ventura and ENH filing on Oslo NewsWeb is in English, and only the category labels are Norwegian (e.g. 'HALVÅRSRAPPORT', 'INNSIDEINFORMASJON').

Norwegian-language searches (fusjon, bytteforhold, verft forsinkelse, aksje faller) returned only English trade-press and aggregator pages. No Finansavisen, E24 or DN article on the deal spread or on Q3 surfaced.
The only non-English items found were Swedish Finwire telegrams (Fearnley target 37 -> 40; Arctic top pick), which MarketScreener also carries in English.
lessons_applied: 'In a live bid, results are noise; the offer is the finding': confirmed the frame already in the draft. The Q3 numbers stay unsized and the transaction and capex/consideration lines carry the name.

'An unexplained drawdown is worth 0' and 'a narrow proxy loses': cut the exchange-ratio catch-up finding from +0.8 to +0.5, because part of the spread widening (the 11-20 VTURA drop) has no cause in the filings.

'Understatement is the systematic error; size the move on what is new': raised abs_move_pct from 4.0 to 4.5, since the acquirer's print, a deal update and the consideration-linked capex update all land in one session.
